track.title: Spanish for Beginners
track.tagline: Speak everyday Spanish in 10 minutes a day

lessons.title: Saying hello
lessons.summary: Greet people politely at any time of day.

sections.b: Buenos días = Good morning. Buenas tardes = Good afternoon. Buenas noches = Good evening / Good night. ¿Qué tal? = How's it going?
Use 'Buenos días' with colleagues and clients in the morning; 'Hola, ¿qué tal?' with friends.
Spanish questions start with an upside-down question mark: ¿Cómo estás?

lessons.example:
A: ¡Hola! ¿Qué tal?
B: Muy bien, gracias. ¿Y tú?
lessons.action: Greet one person in Spanish today (even yourself in the mirror!).

quiz.why: Días = days; used in the morning.

quiz.q: Which question mark opens a Spanish question?
quiz.why: Questions open with ¿ and close with ?.
